from PIL import Image; import numpy as np
im=np.asarray(Image.open('observations/obs_0165.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
blk=(R<45)&(B<50)
mid=(abs(R-76)<14)&((B-R)>=3)&(R<105)          # dark gray-blue top-face tone
mass=(abs(R-120)<12)&((B-R)>=12)                # bright bluish mass tone
tan=(R>120)&(R<200)&((R-B)>10)
px,py=1.352,7.899
def bnd(m,u):
    i=np.where(m[:,u])[0]
    return (int(i.min()),int(i.max())) if len(i)>2 else None
print(' u | blk        mid        mass       tan')
for u in range(288,512,8):
    print('%4d'%u, bnd(blk,u), bnd(mid,u), bnd(mass,u), bnd(tan,u))
print()
print('=== test: is blk bottom a floor-contact line of a constant-y plane? ===')
for u in range(296,344,4):
    b=bnd(blk,u)
    if not b: continue
    v=b[1]
    if v>=511: print(u,'clipped'); continue
    y=py-1.55*(u-256)/(v-256); D=1.55*256.0/(v-256)
    print(' u %d vbot %d -> y %.3f  x %.3f'%(u,v,y,px+D))
" 2>/dev/null
